1545-1981-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1545-1981-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

4279-6255-6578--216.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6255-6578--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

323-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
323-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Falkenrath Noble triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

575-4674-6495.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-4674-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.
575-4674-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-3581-4779-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3581-4779-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
Kykar and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

304-1870-4873-5087.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
304-1870-4873-5087.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
304-1870-4873-5087.description:
Use Tough Cookie to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

654-4499-7894.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}.
654-4499-7894.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Gandalf.
When Gandalf enters, its first ability triggers, blinking the lands tapped for mana in step 1.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor and Gandalf's second ability each trigger three times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands that entered.
Resolve all Gandalf triggers, causing you to draw three cards and put three +1/+1 counters on Gandalf.
Repeat.

1003-2459-6108-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-2459-6108-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1987-3277-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3277-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-3277-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

997-1580-4871-5075.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6135.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Aarakocra Sneak to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

2092-4549-5140-6297.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning King Darien XLVIII from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping King Darien XLVIII, adding {B}.
Activate King Darien XLVIII by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2510-4659-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact and/or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.

1494-4613-5801-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-4613-5801-7152.description:
Cast Mind Peel with buyback by paying {2}{B}{B}{B}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-4613-5801-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Mind Peel. Mind Peel is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

2292-4488-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1579-6797-6972--112.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
1579-6797-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1594-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1594-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

428-1694-2770-4493.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Donate and Irenicus's Vile Duplication.
428-1694-2770-4493.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

225-1170-1770-4124-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1770-4124-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

457-1409-4659.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Construct, adding {U}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Construct, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
457-1409-4659.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

2440-3490-5994.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2440-3490-5994.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the Securitron Squadron trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Servo.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2038-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

176-413-5522.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-413-5522.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2429-3193-5111.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2429-3193-5111.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

413-1734-2150.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes to the battlefield from exile.
When Hero of the Dunes enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Hero of the Dunes trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

215-3821-4115.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
You have no other Drakes on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
215-3821-4115.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
The token Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
The nontoken Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Temur Sabertooth twice by paying {2}{G}{G}, returning the token and nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

914-2397-4770.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2397-4770.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{W}.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1300-3993-4050-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other Shrines.
1300-3993-4050-4222.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Honden of Life's Web triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Honden of Life's Web's ability.
Resolve the copy of Honden of Life's Web's ability, creating at least three 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar two times by sacrificing two Spirit tokens, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Repeat from step 2.

1021-1812-2440-5321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Squirrel.
1021-1812-2440-5321.description:
Activate Squirrel Wrangler by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Drownyard Temple, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Both Squirrel tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice.
Resolve both Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}{C} for each Squirrel on the battlefield.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Repeat.

864-933-2041-2372.description:
Cast Savor the Moment gaining an extra turn.
Move to your end step.
Conjurer's Closet and Wilderness Reclamation trigger.
Resolve Wilderness Reclamation, untapping all lands you control.
Resolve Conjurer's Closet's trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and returning it to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters, returning Savor the Moment from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters

193-2369-3908.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from them, blinking a permanent you own.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from them, blinking Spark Double and choosing to have it enter as a non-legendary copy of Aminatou.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking a permanent you own.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Repeat.
